content: Ayt n Lawi - Ilawiyyen
Arrawen n Lawi tuɣa aten d Jarcun, Qahat d Marari.
Ina d ismawen n warrawen n Jarcun: Libni d Cimɛi.
Arrawen n Qahat tuɣa aten d Ɛamram, Yiṣḥar, Ḥabrun d Ɛuzziyil.
Arrawen n Marari tuɣa aten d Maḥli d Muci. Tina d řaǧat n Ilawiyyen, ɛlaḥsab řejdud nsen.
N Jarcun: mmis Libni, mmis Yaḥat, mmis Zimma,
mmis Yuwax, mmis Ɛiddu, mmis Zaraḥ d mmis Yatray.
Arrawen n Qaḥat: mmis Ɛamminadab, mmis Quraḥ, mmis Assir,
mmis Ilqana, mmis Abiyasaf, mmis Assir,
mmis Taḥat, mmis Uriyil, mmis Ɛuzziya d mmis Cawul.
Arrawen n Ilqana tuɣa aten d Ɛamasay d Aximut.
Ilqana: mmis tuɣa-t Ilqana, mmis Ṣufay, mmis Naḥat,
mmis Iliyab, mmis Yaruḥam d mmis Ilqana.
Arrawen n Camwil tuɣa aten d Yuwil, amenzu nnes, u wenni d wiss tnayen tuɣa-t Abiya.
Arrawen n Marari: Maḥli, mmis Libni, mmis Cimɛi, mmis Ɛuzza,
mmis Cimɛa, mmis Ḥajiya d mmis Ɛasaya.
Ina d inni igga Dawud ḥima ad iřin x uɣennej n yizřan di Taddart n SIDI, awarni řami tuɣa tiweḍ Ttabut ɣar wemcan n arraḥet nnes.
Nitni tuɣa ttsexxaren s izřan zzat i Tzeddiɣt, zzat i Uqiḍun n Umsagar, ař ikemmeř Suliman řebni n Taddart n SIDI di Urcalim. Nitni bedden di tsexxart nsen ɛlaḥsab lfariḍa nsen.
Ina d inni i din ibedden ak-d warrawen nsen: Zeg warrawen n Iqaḥatiyyen: Hayman, amedyaz, mmis n Yuwil, mmis n Camwil,
mmis n Ilqana, mmis n Yaruḥam, mmis n Iliyil, mmis n Tuwaḥ,
mmis n Ṣuf, mmis n Ilqana, mmis n Maḥat, mmis n Ɛamasay,
mmis n Ilqana, mmis n Yuwil, mmis n Ɛazarya, mmis n Ṣafanya,
mmis n Taḥat, mmis n Assir, mmis n Abiyasaf, mmis n Quraḥ,
mmis n Yiṣhar, mmis n Qahat, mmis n Lawi, mmis n Israil.
Umas Asaf tuɣa ittbedda ɣar ufusi nnes. Tuɣa Asaf d mmis n Baraxya, mmis n Cimɛi,
mmis n Mixayil, mmis n Baɛasiya, mmis n Malkiya,
mmis n Itni, mmis n Zaraḥ, mmis n Ɛadaya,
mmis n Itan, mmis n Zimma, mmis n Cimɛi,
mmis n Yaḥat, mmis n Jarcum, mmis n Lawi.
Aytmatsen, arrawen n Marari, bedden ɣar uzeřmaḍ: Itan, mmis n Qici, mmis n Ɛabdi, mmis n Mallux,
mmis n Ḥacabya, mmis n Amaṣya, mmis n Ḥilqiya,
mmis n Amṣi, mmis n Bani, mmis n Camar,
mmis n Maḥli, mmis n Muci, mmis n Marari, mmis n Lawi.
Aytmatsen, Ilawiyyen, tuɣa ttwaggen i qaɛ tsexxart di Tzeddiɣt n Taddart n AREBBI.

Maca Harun d warrawen nnes, inni issbexxaren tiɣarṣa x uɛalṭar n wecmaḍ u x uɛalṭar n řebxur, aqa aten ḥima ad bedden ak-d qaɛ řxedmet deg Weqdas x Uqeddas u ḥima ad ggen aṣřaḥ i Israil am mammec marra min tuɣa yumur Musa, amsexxar n AREBBI.
Ina d arrawen n Harun: mmis Aliɛazar, mmis Finaḥas, mmis Abicuɛa,
mmis Buqqi, mmis Ɛuzzi, mmis Zaraḥ-Yah
mmis Marayut, mmis Amarya, mmis Axiṭub,
mmis Ṣaduq d mmis Aximaɛaṣ.
Ina d imucan mani tuɣa zeddɣen, ɛlaḥsab řemrageḥ nsen x temmurt nsen: i warrawen n Harun, i řaǧ n Iqahatiyyen, minzi tuɣa-tt teqduḥt i nitni.
Wcin asen Ḥabrun di temmurt n Yahuda ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes i d as dd-innḍen.
Iyyar n tendint d dcurat nnes wcin t i Kalib, mmis n Yafunni.
I warrawen n Harun wcin asen tineddam n tarewřa Ḥabrun d Libna ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, Yattir d Ictamuɛa ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
Ḥilayn ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Dabir ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
d Ɛacan ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Bayt-Cams ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.

Zi teqbič n Binyamin ksin nitni Jabɛa ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Ɛallimat ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Ɛanatut ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes. Marra tineddam nsen tuɣa atent d třeṭṭac n tneddam ak-d řaǧat nsen.
I warrawen n Qahat i iqqimen zi řaǧ n teqbič, ttwaɛeyynent s tqedduḥt ɛecra n tneddam zeg wezyen n teqbič, zeg wezyen n Manassa.
I warrawen n Jarcun ttwaɛeyynent ɛlaḥṣab řaǧat nsen zi teqbič n Issakar, u zi teqbič n Acir, u zi teqbič n Naftali, u zi teqbič n Manassa di Bacan třeṭṭac n tneddam.
I warrawen n Marari ɛlahsab řaǧat nsen ttwaɛeyynent s tqedduḥt tenɛac n tneddam zi teqbič n Rubin, u zi teqbič n Jad u zi teqbič n Zabulun.
Ayt n Israil wcin i Ilawiyyen tineddam-a ak-d ddmani nsent n tarewsa.
S tqedduḥt wcin nitni tineddam-a i ittwařaɣan s yisem nsent zi teqbič n warrawen n Yahuda u zi teqbič n warrawen n Cimɛun u zi teqbič n warrawen Binyamin.
Uca zi řaǧat n warrawen n Qahat ṭṭfen nitni ɛawed tineddam zi teqbič n Ifrayim di temmurt nsen.
Minzi wcin asen zi tneddam n tarewřa Cakim ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes x idurar n Ifrayim, d Jazar ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
d Yaqmaɛam ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Bayt-Ḥurun ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
d Ayalun ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes d Jat-Rimmun ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.
Zeg wezyen n teqbič n Manassa ksin nitni Anir ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Bilɛam ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes i min iqqimen zi řaǧ n warrawen n Qahat.
Arrawen n Jarcum ksin ɛawed zi řaǧ n wezyen n teqbič n Manassa: Julan di Bacan ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes d Ɛactarut ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.
U zi teqbič n Issakar ksin nitni Qadac ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, Dubra ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
Ramut ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes u Ɛanim ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.
Zi teqbič n Acir ksin nitni Macal ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Ɛabdun ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
d Ḥuquq ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Raḥub ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.
Zi teqbič n Naftali ksin nitni Qadac di Ljalil ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Ḥammun ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes d Qaryatayim ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.
Inni iqqimen n warrawen n Marari ksin ɛawed zi teqbič n Zabulun Rimmunu ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Tabur ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes
u x ujemmaḍ n L’Urdun ɣar Ariḥa, ccarq n L’Urdun, ksin nitni zi teqbič n Rubin Baṣar di řexřa ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Yahṣa ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
d Qadimut ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Mayfaɛa ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
u zi teqbič n Jad ksin nitni Ramut di Jilɛad ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Maḥanayim ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes,
d Ḥacbun ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes, d Yaɛzir ak-d ddmani n tarewsa nnes.

footnotes.text: Ṣafanya- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘wenni t issnuffaren SIDI’.
